intro: Zurich rewards visitors with a compact old town, lakefront promenades, world-class museums and easy day trips into the Alps. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Trams and buses cover the centre; buy and validate tickets before boarding.
S-Bahn suburban trains link the centre with suburbs and the airport.
Single zone 110 tickets cost about CHF 4-5; 24-hour cards cost about CHF 9-10.
Ride apps like Uber and Bolt operate; local taxi apps also work.
Driving is congested and parking is expensive; public transport is faster.
Walking is easy in the centre; lake boats run from Bürkliplatz in summer.

grossmunster.name: Grossmünster
grossmunster.price_text: ≈ CHF 5 church entry · tower climb extra (check on the day)
grossmunster.hours: Church roughly 10:00–17:00 daily · tower hours vary (check on the day)
grossmunster.tip: Climb the tower for the best old-town view over the river.

fraumunster.name: Fraumünster Church
fraumunster.price_text: ≈ CHF 5 entry to see the Chagall windows (check on the day)
fraumunster.hours: Roughly 10:00–17:00, shorter on Sundays (check on the day)
fraumunster.tip: The five Chagall windows are the reason to come. Go early for quiet.

lindenhof.name: Lindenhof
lindenhof.tip: Sit on the wall for a free view over the Limmat and the old town roofs.

chagall_museum.name: Composition with Red Blue and Yellow (Kunsthaus Zurich)
chagall_museum.landmark: Composition with Red Blue and Yellow
chagall_museum.price_text: ≈ CHF 23 adult · under 16 free (check on the day)
chagall_museum.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 10:00–18:00, Thu late · closed Monday
chagall_museum.tip: The Mondrian hangs in the Kunsthaus collection. Check it is on display before you buy a ticket.

eth.name: ETH Zurich
eth.hours: Campus open on weekdays; some buildings closed at weekends
eth.tip: Walk up the Polyterrasse for a free city view, then ride the Polybahn down.

fifa.name: FIFA World Football Museum
fifa.price_text: ≈ CHF 26 adult · children cheaper (check on the day)
fifa.tip: Good for football fans and rainy days. Allow about two hours.

kunsthaus.name: Kunsthaus Zurich
kunsthaus.price_text: ≈ CHF 23 adult · under 16 free (check on the day)
kunsthaus.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 10:00–18:00, Thu late · closed Monday
kunsthaus.tip: Swiss and international art from the Middle Ages to today. Book online to skip the queue.

limmat_cruise.name: Limmat River Cruise
limmat_cruise.price_text: ≈ CHF 20–40 depending on route (check on the day)
limmat_cruise.hours: Daytime departures, more in summer · check timetable
limmat_cruise.tip: Short boat trips leave from near the Landesmuseum. Sit on the open deck.

uzh.name: University of Zurich
uzh.tip: Walk through the old main building near the Polyterrasse on your way to ETH.

zoo.name: Zurich Zoo
zoo.price_text: ≈ CHF 30 adult · children cheaper (check on the day)
zoo.tip: The Masoala rainforest hall is the highlight. Take tram 6 to the zoo stop.

markthalle.name: Markthalle im Viadukt
markthalle.price_text: Free to enter · food from ≈ CHF 10
markthalle.tip: Covered market under the railway arches. Great for a cheap lunch.

polyterrasse.name: Polyterrasse viewpoint
polyterrasse.tip: Best free view over the old town. Ride the Polybahn up for a few francs.

niederdorf_walk.name: Niederdorf old-town walk
niederdorf_walk.hours: Always open · liveliest in the evening
niederdorf_walk.tip: Wander the narrow lanes for cafés and small shops. Keep an eye on your bag in crowds.

bahnhofstrasse.name: Bahnhofstrasse stroll
bahnhofstrasse.hours: Always open · shops roughly 09:00–20:00, closed Sunday
bahnhofstrasse.tip: Walk from the station to the lake. Most shops close on Sunday.

lake_promenade.name: Lake Zurich promenade
lake_promenade.tip: Walk or swim at the lake in summer. The water is clean and free to enter.

fondue.name: Cheese fondue dinner in the old town
fondue.tip: Book a table for dinner. Fondue is a winter dish, but many places serve it all year.

tram_tour.name: City tram ride (line 4 or 11)
tram_tour.price_text: ≈ CHF 4 single ticket (check zones on the day)
tram_tour.tip: A cheap way to see the city. Buy a ticket before boarding.

chocolatier.name: Chocolate shop tasting
chocolatier.price_text: ≈ CHF 5–15 for a small box or tasting
chocolatier.tip: Try a few pralines before buying a box to take home.

swimming.name: Lake swim at a public bath
swimming.price_text: ≈ CHF 8 entry to a lake bath (check on the day)
swimming.tip: Bring a towel and coins for a locker. Free lake spots exist too.

landesmuseum.name: Swiss National Museum
landesmuseum.tip: Good rainy-day stop near the station. Covers Swiss history and culture.

old_town_food_tour.name: Old-town food walking tour
old_town_food_tour.price_text: ≈ CHF 70–110 per person (check on the day)
old_town_food_tour.hours: Usually one or two departures a day
old_town_food_tour.tip: Book ahead. Tours mix cheese, chocolate and local history.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Old Town lanes, world-class museums and the lakefront.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Lake boats, hilltop views and mountain day trips.

stays.why: Right in the old town by the river and lake; walk to most sights. Quiet at night.
Central and handy for the main station and trams; the shopping street on your doorstep.
Lively old-town quarter with bars and cheap eats; good for nightlife and budget stays.
Quiet, leafy area near the lake and museums; a short tram ride to the centre.

food: Try cheese fondue or raclette in an old-town restaurant; portions are big, so share.
Zurich-style sliced veal in cream sauce (Zürcher Geschnetzeltes) is the local classic.
Markthalle im Viadukt under the railway arches has many small food stalls; good for lunch.
Chocolate shops and cafés are everywhere; a hot chocolate is a cheap treat.
Supermarket sandwiches and takeaway are the budget option; restaurant meals cost much more.
more_time: Take a lake boat from Bürkliplatz in summer and stop at a lakeside village for a walk.
Ride the train to Uetliberg hill for a short hike and city views; check the weather first.
Swap a city afternoon for a day trip to Lucerne or the Rhine Falls by train.
